Eligibility report settings

Source: R/elig_Setup.R
elig_Setup.Rd

`r lifecycle::badge("experimental")`

Settings of the Eligibility report. `NULL` `dfSources` and `vCriterionColors` take the defaults. The result is accepted back by this function unchanged.

Usage

elig_Setup(
  dfSources = NULL,
  strRateMetricID = "Analysis_qtl0001",
  vCriterionColors = NULL,
  strInvestigatorLevel = "Site",
  vInvestigatorParams = c("InvestigatorFirstName", "InvestigatorLastName")
)

Arguments

dfSources

`data.frame` Flag sources with columns `flag`, `label` (chart name), `listing_label` (listing column) and `record_source` (record table in the expanded row). Only `flag` is required; each passed row overrides the defaults of that flag for the passed columns. Passing all six flags sets their display order. Both PD split flags use the `record_source` of `flag_pd`. Defaults:

`flag``label``listing_label``record_source`
`flag_pd`Protocol DeviationPDProtocol Deviation
`flag_pd_important`Important PDImportant PDProtocol Deviation
`flag_pd_nonimportant`Non-important PDNon-important PDProtocol Deviation
`flag_ecrf`EDC eCRFEDC eCRFEDC eCRF
`flag_edc_query`EDC QueryEDC QueryEDC Query
`flag_edc_pd`EDC PDEDC PDEDC PD
strRateMetricID

`character` Analysis metric charted as the eligibility rate. `workflow/4_modules/report_eligibility.yaml` queries only `Analysis_qtl0001`, so the setting matters for direct callers. Default: `"Analysis_qtl0001"`.

vCriterionColors

Named `character` Colours by criterion type; passed names replace the defaults, stack order stays `Inclusion`, `Exclusion`, `Not classified`. Defaults: `"#3C587F"`, `"#8FB3DE"`, `"#B8C4D6"`.

strInvestigatorLevel

`character` Group level of the investigator parameters. Default: `"Site"`.

vInvestigatorParams

`character` Parameters joined into the investigator name. Default: `c("InvestigatorFirstName", "InvestigatorLastName")`.

Value

`list` with `dfSources`, `strRateMetricID`, `vCriterionColors`, `strInvestigatorLevel` and `vInvestigatorParams`.
